# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_FLIP_VOLUME_SPIKE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bullish EMA ribbon flip accompanied by a volume spike indicates a shift in short-term momentum driven by institutional participation. This edge exists because volume-confirmed ribbon alignment suggests sustained buying pressure capable of generating intraday runs, particularly when occurring after the first 30 minutes and under moderate VIX conditions (<25) that avoid extreme volatility regimes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Enter long when price crosses above the 8-period EMA while the 21-period EMA remains above the 55-period EMA (bullish ribbon alignment) and the bar’s volume is at least 2× the 20-bar average volume. Only consider bars after 10:00 ET to avoid opening noise.  
**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: Chart stop at the most recent swing low (prior higher low)  
- Profit target: Prior day’s high OR a runner trail of 15% off the high-water mark (chandelier-style)  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
